comment: The design of the 3D sketch relations UI test (mitcad#1661; tools/ui-sketch3d-relations-test.sh, tools/ui-windows-sketch3d-relations-test.ps1, tools/ui-scripts/sketch3d-relations.mitcad-ui): Box1 (F1, F1.b0) 40 x 30 x 20 at (20, 20), off the origin planes (a face on one would take the plane's pick); 3DSketch1 (F2) on its top face with four free lines in space, none parallel or at right angles to another (c3: p1 to p2, c6: p4 to p5, c9: p7 to p8, c12: p10 to p11) and two free points (p13, p14).
